summary.text: Star Cast is Heavenly Court's immortal killer move that teleports Gu Immortals from Central Continent.

claims.text: In Lang Ya blessed land, four Gu Immortals of Heavenly Court appear. Fang Yuan first thinks the method sent four rank eight Gu Immortals from Central Continent at once, was not at its limit, and could create a tracking effect. Feng Jiu Ge was not rank eight; his dao marks were at rank eight level. Gu Immortals at rank eight have dense dao marks; few methods can transport them, and even space path great experts can usually teleport only themselves. Fairy Zi Wei left Star Constellation Chessboard in Heavenly Court to sustain this killer move; without that, she judges she could unravel Lang Ya’s super immortal formation with dozens of times the efficiency.

Fang Yuan sends a video into treasure yellow heaven that records Heavenly Court using star cast to send multiple rank eight Gu Immortals into Lang Ya blessed land. Super forces of the other four regions are shocked, and their alertness toward Heavenly Court rises sharply.

He keeps mentioning star cast and fate Immortal Gu in treasure yellow heaven, looping videos of the Reverse Flow River battle, the dream realm battle, and the Lang Ya Sect battle, as a record of Heavenly Court meddling in the other four regions.

After rebirth, Fang Yuan already knows the harmful dao marks still in Lang Ya blessed land are a portion of star cast and were left there on purpose by Feng Jiu Ge. In his previous life those dao marks became a spiral tunnel that transported Gu Immortals in.

He delays annexing Lang Ya blessed land so Heavenly Court will come again, in part because he wants star cast exposed: the method can change the situation of all five regions, and once it is known, the four regions’ super forces have cause to attack Heavenly Court. Star Constellation Chessboard shoots starlight across Heavenly Court. Nearly ten Gu Immortals stand ready. The starlight gathers into a huge light blue pillar as Fairy Zi Wei orders the advance, and Thunder Ghost True Monarch rushes in first.

Star cast needs a tracer. That tracer is the harmful dao marks Feng Jiu Ge left. Destroying the dark spiral early cuts the delivery short, so only some of the intended group arrive, and those already inside must stall until the move can be used again. Star Constellation Chessboard must stay in Heavenly Court to maintain the move. Recreating it is not easy. It can transport rank eight Gu Immortals, so the price is huge in immortal essence and in preparation time with countless complex steps, and without deep wisdom path attainment it is unusable. Fairy Zi Wei judges that if Heavenly Court regained Wisdom Gu, activating star cast would become an easy feat.

The dark spiral is the tracer and has detection abilities. If dream realms or Reverse Flow River are nearby, Fairy Zi Wei can sense them. Contact with either makes star cast unstable and causes it to fail. She can make a slightly larger dark spiral to test for those things. During the Lang Ya fight the move is only half prepared. In the previous life she and Feng Jiu Ge were separated only by yama battlefield, and she broke that battlefield to save him. Now they are apart by a vast distance.

Fairy Zi Wei later tells Duke Long that Heavenly Court lost the battle of Lang Ya blessed land because star cast was broken, and she finds it suspicious that Fang Yuan locked onto one of Feng Jiu Ge’s many dao marks and set a formation in advance.
Fang Yuan answers Heavenly Court’s rumor campaign by exposing star cast and the deaths of Chen Yi and Thunder Ghost True Monarch. Countless Gu Immortals gasp in shock.

Gu Immortals of the four regions are extremely shocked. Star cast has huge significance in war: Central Continent and Heavenly Court can deploy Gu Immortals and attack suddenly without needing time to travel, which gives Heavenly Court the complete initiative. Gu Immortals of the four regions at rank eight are usually leaders of their own forces and cannot simply band together in advance, so Heavenly Court can use the move to pile several rank eight battle strengths onto one target.
